newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH buys winemaker for 1 bln Ffr -paper.
newsitem.headline: LVMH buys winemaker for 1 bln Ffr -paper.

text.p: French luxury goods group LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton has bought control of Sauternes Chateau d'Yquem, a maker of one of France's most prestigious regional wines, French newspapers reported on Thursday.
The newspapers said LVMH bought the group for around one billion francs.
The Le Figaro newspaper said it was LVMH's first acquisition of a winemaker. It said the main export destinations of the wines were the United States followed by Japan.
Chateau d'Yquem belongs to the Lur-Saluces family.
LVMH had been reported to be in the process of buying a stake in Chateau d'Yquem in September. At that time, LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault refused to comment on the report.
LVMH could not be reached for comment on Thursday.
